title: Link response observation
description: Close context written by SemanticLogLinker: the resource object the request with links returned. exception replaces uri and code when following the links threw.

uri.description: Canonical uri (path only) of the resource object returned: from bear/resource 1.37, the last resource followed or the one that answered 400 or more and stopped the links.

durationMs.description: Wall time of all the requests made to follow the links, in milliseconds.
